svg.aria-label: Mapas de PCA y t-SNE de los mismos cuatro grupos
svg.title: Mapas de PCA y t-SNE de los mismos cuatro grupos
svg.desc: Four groups of 50 points in 10 dimensions, where A is tight, B is wide, and C and D lie close together and far from A and B. The linear PCA view keeps the sizes and the gaps but lets C and D overlap. With perplexity 10, t-SNE separates all four groups and gives them similar sizes and even gaps. Perplexity 2 breaks the groups into fragments, and perplexity 150 gives a coarse global layout in which nearby groups drift together.
svg.text: PCA: C y D se solapan
